newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow higher Chicago futures.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow higher Chicago futures.

text.p: Firm Chicago futures overnight on forecasts of tight soybean supplies and talk of business to China pushed UK meals and feeds prices higher on Thursday.
Nearby soymeal was four stg up ex-mill and one to two stg higher in the deferred months.
Store were around three stg up from Wednesday.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged while Liverpool and Hull prices were two stg up.
Corn gluten feed pellets in Liverpool and Portbury were unchanged to one stg higher.
